title: Beztack Origin baseline
description: Schema-versioned Origin baseline. Records the Template revision a Derived project last accepted and per-file metadata for drift detection.

derivedProjectId.description: Opaque stable Derived project identifier generated at scaffolding.

templateRevision.description: Template revision tag or commit accepted as the Origin baseline.

files.description: Per-file metadata. Keys are Derived-project-relative paths.

templateHash.description: Hash of the file as it appeared in the accepted Template revision.

projectHash.description: Hash of the file as it appeared in the Derived project at acceptance.
